description: Hide a background process's terminal tab (process keeps running) in the Hermes desktop GUI (the tabs mirroring terminal(background=true) runs). This does NOT kill the process — it only drops the tab/view; the output keeps buffering and the user can reopen it from the status stack. Use it to tidy up when a background process's live terminal is no longer worth showing. To actually stop the process, use process(action='kill') instead.
name: close_terminal

process_id.description: The background process's session id (from terminal(background=true) output or process(action='list')) whose tab should be closed.
